# The Librarian Abroad

> Notes from the road and from the table: what was worth the trip, what was worth the plate, and what wasn't.

Mostly restaurant and place reviews around Vancouver, WA and Portland, OR, plus trips.

Part of the m8k.io family of publications by "Mr. Librarian" (index: https://m8k.io/llms.txt).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://abroad.m8k.io/): newest posts
- [About](https://abroad.m8k.io/about.html): who writes this

## Notes for automated readers

- Every published post is listed in https://abroad.m8k.io/sitemap.xml (with last-modified dates) and the newest in https://abroad.m8k.io/feed.xml.
- This blog moved from mistertranslation.com/travel/ on 2026-10-10; old addresses 301 here.
